scope: YSZ electrolyte and YDC blocking-layer oxide purchases for the existing nominal 1 MWe SOEC stack; not a reconstruction or validation of the complete stack.

sources.evidence: Mixed Sm/Eu/Gd concentrate was an environmental-impact proxy for unavailable yttrium, not an actual rare-earth ingredient. SOEC stack scales from 1 kW to 1 MW using exponent 0.88. Figure 5 lists rounded 170.7 kg zirconium proxy + 14.8 kg yttrium proxy and 91.5 kg cerium proxy + 22.9 kg yttrium proxy. Concentrates are not chemical-purity assays.

Original supplement Fig. S1 and Table S2 identify a YDC blocking layer and alternative air electrodes. Main-article numerical BOM was not directly accessible in this correction. 0.425 kg YSZ/kW and 0.262 kg YDC/kW are reconstructed from the Gerloff rounded table and the separately attributed Haefele elemental observations in the packaged SI_2_Material_requirements.xlsx. The chosen chemistry reproduces those elemental observations within 0.001 kg/MW before capacity scaling. Do not describe this as a newly measured or fully validated stack design.
Experimental section explicitly uses 8 mol% Y2O3-stabilized ZrO2; supports the chemical convention, not the complete Gerloff design.
Studies Ce0.8Y0.2-xCuxO2-delta including x=0. Supports 20% Y on cation sites as a physical YDC composition, not a measurement of this stack.

reference.composition_status: Explicit reference compositions: 8 mol% Y2O3 among binary oxides for YSZ; Ce0.8Y0.2O1.9 for YDC. Consistent with attributed source coefficients, but not independently verified for a manufacturer-specific whole stack.
reference.capacity_status: Retains Gerloff capacity exponent for continuity with the existing foreground inventory. This is an empirical scaling assumption, not proof that active ceramic mass scales sublinearly. A linear-capacity sensitivity is provided.
reference.purchase_yield_status: Assume 100% incorporation at oxide-purchase boundary; rejects, deposition losses and recycling are not quantified.

projection.status: User-selected assumption: retain the existing 2050 contained-Y central target and proportionally reduce the complete YSZ/YDC package. Preserve constant composition and component ratio; interpolate all three elements together. The target is not a documented complete future stack or demonstrated performance.
projection.historical_endpoint_status: Previous workbook took 0.47 kg Y/MW as a literature minimum and current minimum 11.56334492168543 as future maximum; central target was their mean. These cross-study limits are not measurement uncertainty for one matched design.
projection.bound_policy: Deterministic reference coefficients: mean=median=min=max. Future uncertainty is represented by explicit scenarios, not independent element sampling.

limitations: Complete SOEC stack remains unvalidated: alternative air-electrode mixtures, Ni/YSZ support, uncertain La/Sr quantities, glass-sealant silicone proxy, steel, manufacturing and lifetime are separate issues.
Existing hydrogen-production lifetime/replacement allocation is retained. No additional lifetime multiplier on kg/stack.
No change to primary/secondary shares or supplier production shares.
Direct purchased oxides are not the full upstream metal footprint. Proxy overlap was functional, not direct double-counting of measured yttrium.
Scenario caches and saved results require rebuilding; restart Python to clear cached metal coefficients.
